definitionSource: One unscoped single-property ignoreCasing unique definition over a plain string field. The kernel hashes the UTF-8 SHA-256 of string.ToLowerInvariant() over the dash-joined property strings; every case is a fresh scenario. The admitted non-ASCII scalars are exactly U+00C9, U+00DF, U+00E9, U+00F8 and U+0301; there is no normalization and no full Unicode case folding. Measured with the packaged Chronicle 19.30.0 engine on .NET 11.0.0 on macOS arm64 with ICU globalization (InvariantGlobalization not set); Linux CI parity is checked by yarn oracle:check.
